ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black (approximately 98%) with sparse high-intensity white/grey pixels (approximately 2%) localized to small surface spots and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A near-uniform low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white punctate dots are scattered across the surface, notably on the inner left lobe. No macro-scale contiguous white pigment blocks are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary. The right lobe trailing edge features approximately 5-7 distinct peaks of varying pixel-amplitude. The left lobe exhibits lower-frequency, shallower variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave trailing edge sweep transitioning to convex curves at the distal tips that sweep upward and outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast white, pink, and grey pixel groups (barnacles) situated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, disrupting the smooth contour of the edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct light-colored linear streaks visible: several vertical-to-diagonal rake marks on the mid-left lobe and a few fainter horizontal linear disruptions on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive sessile barnacle colonization at the fluke apices (tips) and multiple visible linear rake marks across the ventral surface of both lobes.
